item.title: Kashmir: Truck Driver Electrocuted After Vehicle Contacts High-Tension Wire
item.description: BUDGAM: A truck driver was injured after receiving an electric shock when his vehicle came into contact with a high-tension power line in the Sonpah area of Berwah, officials said on Sunday. The injured driver was initially taken to Sub-District Hospital Berwah, from where he was referred to SMHS Hospital Srinagar for advanced medical treatment.
